skill.name: google-drive-automation
skill.description: Automate Google Drive upload, download, search, folder, and sharing workflows through Rube MCP and Composio Google Drive tools.
skill.summary: Use Rube MCP to automate Google Drive files, folders, searches, downloads, and sharing permissions.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting in SKILL.md. The real risks are a remote Rube MCP trust boundary and Google Drive permission automation that can expose files if used without confirmation. No prompt injection or hidden override text was found.

remediation.suggestion: Disclose the Rube MCP endpoint, OAuth scopes, and data handling expectations before users connect Google Drive.
Require explicit user confirmation for type='anyone', domain-wide sharing, owner, writer, organizer, and delete permission changes.
Treat s3url download links as sensitive, avoid logging them, and remove them when no longer needed.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Google Drive connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `googledrive`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `file_to_upload`: Object with `name`, `mimetype`, and `s3key` (file must be in internal storage)
- `folder_to_upload_to`: Target folder ID (optional; uploads to root if omitted)
- `mime_type`: Export format for Google Workspace files only (omit for native files)
- `GOOGLEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FILE` requires `file_to_upload.s3key`; files must already be in internal stora
- For non-Google formats (Excel, PDF), do NOT set `mime_type`; it causes errors for native files
- Download responses provide a temporary URL at `data.downloaded_file_content.s3url`, not inline byt
- Use `GOOGLEDRIVE_RESUMABLE_UPLOAD` for files >5MB or when basic uploads fail
1. `GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE` - Search by name, content, type, date, or folder [Required]
5. `GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_ABOUT` - Check storage quota and supported formats [Optional]
- `folder_id`: Scope search to a specific folder
- Pagination required; files are in `response.data.files`; follow `nextPageToken` until exhausted
- Wildcards (*) NOT supported in `name`; use `contains` for partial matching
- 'My Drive' is NOT searchable by name; use `folder_id='root'` for root folder
- User email searches: use `'user@example.com' in owners` (NOT `owner:user@example.com`)
- Using `type='anyone'` or powerful roles is risky; get explicit user confirmation
- Use `GMAIL_SEARCH_PEOPLE` to resolve contact names to emails before sharing
- `parent_id`: Parent folder ID (NOT name); omit for root
- `remove_parents`: Source folder ID to remove from
- `GOOGLEDRIVE_CREATE_FOLDER` requires `parent_id` as an ID, not a folder name
- Using `parent_id="root"` creates at top level; for nested paths, chain folder IDs
- `GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE` returns ~100 items/page; follow `nextPageToken` for large drives
- Move operations can leave items with multiple parents; use `remove_parents` for true moves
- Combine with `and`/`or`/`not`: `"name contains 'report' and trashed = false"`
- Follow `nextPageToken` until absent for complete results
For Google Workspace files, set `mime_type` to export:
- **Export vs download**: Set `mime_type` ONLY for Google Workspace files; omit for native files
- **Temporary URLs**: Downloaded content via `s3url` is temporary; fetch promptly
- **No wildcards**: Use `contains` operator instead of `*` for partial name matching
- **Folder creation chains**: Always pass folder IDs (not names) as `parent_id`
- **Multiple parents**: Move operations may leave items with multiple parents; use `remove_parents`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k

content.value_statement: Manual Drive file work slows routine operations and increases permission mistakes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for search, uploads, downloads, folders, and sharing.
actual_capabilities: Connects through Rube MCP after confirming Google Drive authorization status.
Finds and lists Drive files with query, folder, corpora, fields, sorting, and pagination options.
Uploads small files and provides resumable upload guidance for larger files.
Downloads files and exports Google Workspace documents with supported MIME formats.
Creates folders, moves files, and manages sharing permissions using Drive IDs.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Google Drive OAuth connection before workflows run.
Basic upload guidance is limited to 5 MB; larger files need resumable upload.
Uploads require files to already exist in internal storage with an s3key.
Google Drive permissions, shared drive policies, and rate limits may block actions.

use_cases.title: Organize recurring files
use_cases.description: Find, organize, and share recurring Drive files without manually browsing folders.

use_cases.title: Export analysis assets
use_cases.description: Export Sheets, download reports, and collect metadata across shared drives for analysis handoffs.

use_cases.title: Prepare project spaces
use_cases.description: Create project folder structures, move assets, and review permissions before stakeholder sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Find a file
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Google Drive automation skill to search for files named [name]. Return matching names, IDs, owners, and modified dates. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Upload and verify
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [file name] from internal storage to folder [folder name or ID]. Verify the folder ID first and confirm the uploaded file metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Create project folders
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Drive folder structure for [project]. Check whether each folder exists first, then create missing folders under [parent folder].

prompt_templates.title: Review sharing changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [file or folder], list current permissions, propose the minimum sharing change for [recipient], and wait for my confirmation before applying it.

output_examples.input: Search for quarterly planning PDFs in shared drives.
output: Found three matching PDF files across shared drives.
Listed each file name, Drive ID, owner, location, and last modified date.
Recommended narrowing by team folder because one result had a similar title.

output_examples.input: Create folders for a new client project.
output: Checked the parent folder and found no matching project folder.
Created the requested folder structure under the selected parent ID.
Verified each folder by reading its metadata after creation.

output_examples.input: Share the budget sheet with Priya as a commenter.
output_examples.output: Found the sheet, resolved Priya email, listed current permissions, and requested confirmation before adding commenter access.

best_practices: Confirm the Google Drive connection and current tool schemas before running workflows.
Resolve names to IDs and verify metadata after uploads, downloads, moves, or folder creation.
Request explicit confirmation before public, domain, owner, writer, organizer, or delete permission changes.
anti_patterns: Using file or folder names where Google Drive APIs require IDs.
Setting export MIME types for native PDF, Excel, or other non-Workspace files.
Running broad shared-drive searches without pagination, fields, and rate-limit planning.

faq.question: Does this skill require Rube MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires Rube MCP and an active Google Drive connection before any workflow can run.

faq.question: Can it upload large files?
faq.answer: Yes, but files over 5 MB should use the resumable upload workflow described by the skill.

faq.question: Can it search shared drives?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes shared drive listing and all-drives search guidance when permissions allow access.

faq.question: Does it change sharing permissions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add, update, list, and remove permissions, so confirm sensitive changes before applying them.

faq.question: Can it download Google Docs or Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. Google Workspace files need an export MIME type, while native files should omit that setting.

faq.question: Is a third-party service involved?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill routes Drive workflows through Rube MCP, so users should understand that trust boundary.
